title: Kumasi, Ashanti — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Kumasi, Ashanti: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Kumasi is a city in Ashanti with a population of 2,100,000. The historic capital of the Ashanti Kingdom and Ghana’s second-largest city, known for its rich culture and Kejetia Market. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 22.0.
